sources.claim: 61.4% of 310 participants in a local Tiruchengode survey believed a worm is present in a decayed tooth. The result is local, with no statewide inference.

Plaque bacteria use sugar and starch to make acid. Repeated attacks demineralize enamel. Fluoride can assist remineralization at the early white-spot stage. A cavity is permanent damage and needs dental treatment.
Plaque acidity rises rapidly after exposure to carbohydrate and recovers over variable times. The draft labels the supplied timings as approximate.
Clove oil can provide temporary relief of toothache. The video gives no application instructions.
A dark spot, discomfort or tooth pain warrants a dentist's assessment.
